name: Slope Chart
summary: Two-period slope chart — each line joins an item's value in period A to period B, with labels on both sides, up/down colouring and the target highlighted.
summary_zh: 两期斜率图：每条线连接同一对象在两个时点的数值，两侧标注名称和数值，按升降着色并突出目标公司。
description_zh: 用来展示“从 A 到 B 发生了什么变化”：如同业 EV/EBITDA 从 2025E 到 2026E 的变化、投行排名的升降、各业务板块收入的增长。支持宽表（encode.from / encode.to 两个字段）或长表（encode.period + encode.value，取两期）。线的斜率即变化方向和幅度；两侧标签自动避让并用引线连接，目标公司用 accent2 突出，可加中位数虚线作为同业基准。适合 4–20 个对象。
best_for: Segment or region growth between two years
avoid_when: More than ~20 items (labels become unreadable — use a dot plot or table)
More than two periods (use a line chart or small multiples)
Values in different units on each side

from.desc: Wide data: value in the first period

to.desc: Wide data: value in the second period

period.desc: Long data: period field (use with value; two periods are compared)

value.desc: Long data: value field (rows per label and period are summed)

highlight.desc: Boolean flag marking the target row(s), drawn in accent2

group.desc: Optional group for colorBy 'category' and the tooltip

periods.desc: Long data: [fromPeriod, toPeriod]; default = first and last distinct period

headers.desc: [left, right] column headers; default = period values, or field titles minus their common words

colorBy.desc: direction (increase / decrease) | neutral (grey; target in accent2) | category

good.desc: Direction mode: which way is favourable — 'up' or 'down' (e.g. ranks)

highlight.desc: Label value(s) to emphasise in addition to encode.highlight rows

median.desc: Dashed median line across both periods

change.desc: Append the % change to the right-hand labels

labels.desc: both = names on both sides | right = names on the right only | values = no names

inverse.desc: Reverse the value axis (rank 1 at the top)

format.desc: Value format; defaults to the from / value field format

labelWidth.desc: Maximum name width in px before truncation

interactions: Hover a line to focus it (others fade) with a tooltip of both values and the change
Click a line to cross-filter on the label
Selected items stay bright, others dim
Lines draw from left to right on entry; morph on filter changes
